content: Séi á, ndeklé mbɛ́ɛ, nɔ́tɔɩ́ kplá mlɩá mlɩgyí ahandɛ Kristo ɔpasuatɔ. Ɔpasua ɔhandɛ mɩ́ ɛ́ ngyi. Ntráa ngyi ipian ámʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lówun amʋ ɩwɩ adánsɩɛ ogyípʋ́. Mɩ́ ɛ́ nénya mʋ numnyam amʋ́ʋ́ ɩbɛ́lɩn ɔwan ámʋ ɩkʋ.

Ndɛ mlɩ kokóli mbɛ́ɛ, mlɩkɩ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu lapʋ́wá mlɩ ɩbɩtɔ amʋsʋ wankláán fɛ́ akúfa ɔkpapʋ́. Ɩmábwɛ mlɩ fɛ́ bʋdɛ mlɩ hɩɛ, mboún mlɩbwɛ mʋ́ tsu mlɩ klʋntɔ alɩá Bulu déklé. Megyí sika ɔnsɩ́pɛ sʋ, mboún ɔdwɛá mlɩbʋ ha osum ámʋ sʋ.
Mlɩmábwɛ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu lapʋ́wá mlɩ ɩbɩtɔ ámʋ kpóunkpóun. Mboún mlɩtsia tsiátɔ́ wankláán ánɩ́ ɩbɔ́bwɛ nfántʋ́hʋ́n há amʋ́,
mɛ́nɩ ɛkɛá Kristo, ogyi akúfa akpapʋ́ Owíe amʋ ɔbá á, ɔbɛ́ha mlɩ ɩsʋgyí-ɩpa ánɩ́ ɩbʋ numnyam, ɩmɛ́ɛkpa ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.

Nyasubi mʋ́a mbitebí, mlɩ ɛ́ mlɩpʋ obú há mlɩ ahandɛ. Mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ mlɩpʋ ɩwɩasɩbá kpa aba. Tsúfɛ́ bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ bɛɛ, “Bulu tɔkʋ́sʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ ɩwɩ atsupʋ́sʋ́, támɛ ɔtɔwá awɩtɔlɛ há ahá ánɩ́ bɛba ɩwɩasɩ.”
Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩba ɩwɩasɩ, amlɩpʋ mlɩ ɩwɩ wa Bulu túmi kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ ámʋ asɩ, fówun obótsu mlɩ fʋ́á mʋ brɛ́ wankláántɔ́.
Mlɩpʋ mlɩ asʋn wunhɛ fɛ́ɛ́ wa Bulu ɩbɩtɔ, tsúfɛ́ ɔtɔgywɩ́ɩn mlɩ ɩwɩ.
Mlɩkɩta ɩwɩ, amlɩdɩnka ansɩ́ ɩwɩsʋ, tsúfɛ́ mlɩ olupʋ́, ogyi Ɔbʋnsám ná odekpoún, odeki fɛ́ gyatá, ɔdɛ ɔkʋ dunká ɔkɩta wɩ.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ mlɩkɩta mlɩ hógyitɔ kínkíínkín, amlɩtin mʋ ɔkpa. Mlɩbɩ ánɩ́ mlɩ aba Akristofɔ ánɩ́ bʋbʋ ɔyɩ́tɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋdɛ ipian ánfɩ odu wúun.

Támɛ Bulu hɩ́ɛ́ ɔbʋ awɩtɔlɛ há mlɩ tógyítɔ́tɔ́. Mʋlátɩ́ mlɩ ba mʋ numnyamtɔ tsʋn mlɩa Kristonyɔ ɩkʋlɛbwɛtɔ́. Mʋ numnyam amʋ bʋ ɩnʋ brɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́. Nɩ́ mlowun ipian kpalobí á, ɩmɔ́ɔwa ɔpá mʋ onutó obótsu mlɩ kʋ́sʋ́, há mléyinkí lɩ́ɩ́. Ɔbɔ́wa mlɩ ɔwʋnlɩ́n, há mlɛ́lɛ nlín Kristotɔ.

Silwano lɛ́tsa mɩ́ nɔwanlɩ́n ɔwʋlʋ́ kútúklú ánfɩ sɩ́sɩ́ mlɩ. Nyin ánɩ́ opíó Okristoyin ogyi, ɔbʋ ɔnɔkwalɩ. Ndekléá nɔ́wa mlɩ ɔwʋnlɩ́n, mɩ́ angyi adánsɩɛ suna mlɩ ánɩ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ nabláa mlɩ ɔwʋlʋ́ ánfɩtɔ fɛ́ɛ́ idesuná ánɩ́ ɩ́nɩ gyí Bulu awɩtɔlɛ onutónutó ámʋ nɩ. Mlɩkɩta mʋ́tɔ́ kínkíínkín.
Mlɩ apíó ahógyipʋ amʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ Babilon ɔpasuatɔ bɛhá mlɩ itsiá. Mɩ́ bí Marko ɛ́ ɔhá mlɩ itsiá.
Mlɩpʋ aba-ɔdwɛ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ Akristofɔtɔ ámʋ ha aba itsiá brégyíbrɛ́. Ndɛ Bulu kʋlɩ́ mbɛ́ɛ, ɔháa mlɩ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ mlɩgyí Akristofɔ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ iwilwii.
